description.fun: Picture a Donphan with gigantic tusks, tough scales and a savage temper. Great Tusk is named after a creature in the Scarlet Book, the journal of an expedition that met it 200 years ago, and whether it's Donphan's ancient ancestor or a Donphan from another timeline is still a mystery. Its tusks are so big that, unlike Donphan, it rarely curls up into a ball.
description.guide: A Ground and Fighting-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Scarlet, said to be either an ancient relative of Donphan or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It takes its name from a creature recorded in an expedition journal 200 years ago. Its futuristic counterpart is Iron Treads.
description.tagline: A savage, giant-tusked Donphan from the distant past, maybe
